What Dukan ERP replaces

The daily tools that cost shops time and money.

  • Notebooks

    Stock, credit and cash on paper are slow to check and easy to lose.

  • Scattered messages

    Orders, prices and reminders spread across chats that nobody can search later.

  • Uncertain stock

    Nobody knows for sure what is on the shelf, what was sold and what came back.

  • Unclear money positions

    Cash, mobile accounts and customer debts that never quite add up at closing time.

  • Uncontrolled access

    Employees who can see or change anything, with no record of who did what.

Six parts of one application, built for the counter and the back room.

Two activities, one application

A business runs one of them or both, store by store.

Retail and electronics

Phones, accessories, appliances and other goods.

  • Stock received by scanning or typing
  • Serialised devices followed from reception to sale or return
  • Sales, returns, expenses and the daily closing

Money services

Cash exchanged for mobile-money credit on behalf of customers.

  • Exchanges recorded in both directions
  • The commission typed per exchange and kept as the agent’s own revenue
  • Floats and activity followed provider by provider

How it works

Three steps, from the first conversation to a closed day.

  1. 1

    Talk to TSX-MR

    Tell us about your shop or agency, its stores and its team.

  2. 2

    Set up the business in the app

    Stores, employees and their roles, payment accounts and the first stock.

  3. 3

    Run the day

    Sell, receive, record exchanges, count the drawer and close against what was expected.

Built in Nouakchott, in three languages

Dukan ERP and this website are built for Arabic, French and English. Arabic is laid out from right to left throughout, while numbers, amounts and identifiers keep their reading order.

  • Support in the language of the business
  • Works on the phones the team already has
  • Made for the way shops and agencies work here

Trust, privacy and support

These protections are part of how Dukan ERP is built.

Read the privacy policySecurity pageSupport
  • Passwords and PINs are stored only as one-way hashes, never in readable form.
  • Changes to business records are written to an audit trail that the application itself cannot edit or delete.
  • Permissions are granted per person and per store, and the server checks them on every request.
  • Signed-in sessions can be ended, and devices removed from an account, at any time.

Bring your business onto Dukan ERP

Businesses apply for an account online. A new business can start one 7-day free trial from its business account; paid access afterwards is arranged with the TSX-MR team.
